description: Sauna Monthly is an independent editorial site on saunas, heaters, cold plunges and recovery gear. This plugin lets ChatGPT search its catalogue of 83 products with real specifications, US prices and where to buy; read the site's reviews and editorial ratings; compare two to four products side by side; size a sauna heater from room dimensions; estimate what a sauna costs to run from heater power, session length and your electricity rate; and read any of its 32 articles, from brand reviews to the research behind heat and cold. Every answer links to the page it came from on saunamonthly.com. No account is needed and nothing about you or the conversation is stored.

defaultPrompt: Which barrel saunas under $9,000 does Sauna Monthly cover, and which one do they rate highest?
Compare the Nootka 8ft barrel with Redwood's 6-person barrel.
What size heater do I need for an 8 by 6 by 7 foot outdoor sauna in a cold climate?
